title: Preallocate CONCAT result buffer
description: Replace CONCAT evaluation's empty String result with a conservative preallocated result buffer helper.

criteria: CONCAT evaluation no longer starts from String::new
CONCAT argument evaluation remains single-pass and in order
Focused helper test covers the initial capacity policy

notes: The helper uses the argument count as a conservative initial String capacity.
Argument evaluation still happens exactly once per argument inside the existing loop.
append_concat_value and scalar/fallback text conversion behavior are unchanged.
